name: Thomas E. Long

career.title: Vice President and Chief Financial Officer

background_rationale: Served as chief financial officer at DCP Midstream Partners, Matrix Service, Regency and Energy Transfer before becoming co-CEO.

notable.summary: Energy Transfer disclosed that co-CEO Marshall McCrea would retire on or before Dec. 31, 2026, after which Long will become sole CEO.
Energy Transfer announced a fully subscribed expansion of its Nederland, Texas, export terminal adding 240,000 barrels per day of ethane export capacity, with phased startup from 2028.
Energy Transfer, Sunoco, SunocoCorp and USA Compression changed their state of formation from Delaware to Texas, effective July 6, 2026.
Energy Transfer announced it would move its common unit listing from the NYSE to the Texas Stock Exchange, effective Oct. 5, 2026; Long has served on the TXSE board since July 2024.

personal_story.hook: Tom Long built his career as a midstream-energy CFO before becoming co-CEO of Energy Transfer in 2021.
personal_story.summary: Little about Long's early life is public. After seven years in executive roles at Duke Energy subsidiaries starting in 1998, he became CFO of DCP Midstream Partners, then of Matrix Service Company in 2008 and of Regency GP in 2010. He went on to serve as Energy Transfer's CFO and was named co-CEO alongside Mackie McCrea in January 2021. He is slated to become sole CEO when McCrea retires, on or before Dec. 31, 2026.
